title: Outage Replanning
prompt: Replan the outage response sequence given the current memory state.
prompt_zh: 请根据当前记忆状态重排故障响应流程。

title: Incident Risks
prompt: List the key blockers, risks, and unresolved issues affecting service restoration.
prompt_zh: 请列出当前影响服务恢复的关键阻塞项、风险和待决问题。

title: Decision Audit
prompt: Judge whether it is consistent with the meeting to restore full traffic now and announce compensation to all users.
prompt_zh: 请判断“现在恢复全部流量并立即向所有用户发出补偿说明”是否与会议结论一致。
